description: Exact-phrase keyword search over the original text. Use it instead of search_context for exact identifiers and citations that vector search blurs: legal norms and article numbers ('Art. 33', '§ 25a KWG', '2016/679'), defined terms, quotes. Terms must appear adjacent and in order. Same result format as search_context; works without an embedding model.

date_from.description: Optional: only documents dated on or after this day (mails: their own date), YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY; inclusive. Documents without a date are left out.

date_to.description: Optional: only documents dated on or before this day (mails: their own date), YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY; inclusive. Documents without a date are left out.

document_ids.description: Optional: restrict to these documents (ids from list_documents); they must belong to the given contexts.

folder.description: Optional: only documents whose folder path in the collection contains this text, case-insensitive (e.g. "lay-k/sent"); "/inbox/" matches a whole folder name.

sender.description: Optional: only mails (and their attachments) whose sender (From: name or address) contains this text, case-insensitive. Other documents are left out.

term.description: Exact phrase / identifier to look up.

name: lookup_exact
